newsitem.title: USA: Tenet to take Q4 reorganization charge.
newsitem.headline: Tenet to take Q4 reorganization charge.

text.p: Tenet Healthcare Corp said it will take a non-recurring charge in its fourth quarter related to a plan it is developing to close or sell some of its facilities and reorganize its physician practices.

The consolidation will result from the merger earlier this year with Nashville, Tennessee-base OrNda HealthCorp, from which Tenet acquired 50 acute care hospitals and other healthcare facilities. Tenet now has 127 acute care hospitals plus rehabilitation hospitals, surgical centers and long term care centers.
A Tenet spokesman said the company does not yet know the size of the charge or the extent of the reorganization.
